purpose: Base geographic layers for the 2022 campaign prototype
license: Natural Earth data is public domain; attribution is appreciated.
known_limitations: These are general-purpose Natural Earth geographic boundaries, not a verified historical snapshot for every day of 2022.
Admin 1 is first-level administrative geography, not a uniform province/strategic-province system; subdivision detail varies by country.
Some disputed or dependent territories have source-specific representations. The game must store political control, claims, and recognition separately from geometry.
Natural Earth Admin 1 dataset is marked beta in its source documentation.
ISO_A3 may contain -99 for some entities; use country_id as the internal stable key within this dataset.
